description_en: Queries the physical port information of a Smart Access Gateway device
description_zh: 调用DescribeSagPortList接口查询智能接入网关设备物理端口信息
name: DescribeSagPortList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the associated Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

Mac.description_en: The MAC address of the port

Role.description_en:
The port role. Valid values:

NONE: The port role is unassigned.
WAN: The port is a WAN port. A WAN port is used to connect to the Internet and supports DHCP client, PPPoE, and static IP access methods.
LAN: The port is a LAN port. A LAN port is used to connect to local clients or switches and supports DHCP server and static IP access methods.
ECC: The port is a dedicated connection port used to connect to a dedicated connection.
MGT: The port is a management port.
CELLULAR: The port is a 4G port
Role.description_zh:
端口角色：

NONE：表示未分配端口角色。
WAN：端口角色为WAN口，WAN口用于接入Internet，支持DHCP client、PPPoE、静态IP接入方式。
LAN：端口角色为LAN口，LAN口用于接入本地客户端或交换机，支持DHCP server、静态IP接入方式。
ECC：端口角色为专线，用于对接专线。
MGT：端口角色为管理口。
CELLULAR：表示4G口

Status.description_en:
The port status. Valid values:

Up: The port is enabled.
Down: The port is disabled.
Unavailable: The device is offline
Status.description_zh:
端口状态：

Up：端口开启。
Down：端口关闭。
Unavailable：设备不在线

TaskStates.description_en: The status of the query task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the query task was created

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. A value of 200 indicates that the query task is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。200标识查询任务成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. A value of Successful indicates that the query task is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息。Successful标识查询任务成功

State.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:

Initialized: The query task is initialized.
Offline: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task is not delivered. The task will be delivered after the device goes online.
Succeed: The query task is delivered.
Processing: The query task is being delivered.
VersionNotSupport: The current version of the Smart Access Gateway device does not support this feature.
BuildRequestError: The management and control system does not support this operation.
HardwareError: The query task failed to be delivered due to a device error.
TaskNotExist: The query task does not exist.
OfflineNotConfiged: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task is not delivered. The task will not be delivered after the device goes online
State.description_zh:
异步任务状态：

Initialized：查询任务初始化。
Offline：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后会继续下发。
Succeed：查询任务下发成功。
Processing：查询任务下发中。
VersionNotSupport：智能接入网关设备当前版本不支持。
BuildRequestError：管控不支持。
HardwareError：由于设备原因查询任务下发失败。
TaskNotExist：查询任务不存在。
OfflineNotConfiged：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后也不会下发
